summary: Iteration 10 (PORTAL PASIEN) — Backend 133/133 pytest pass (25 new portal pasien tests + 108 regression). Frontend sanity verified: pasien-login page, clinic-login-link, admin login + akun-create modal (username/password + copy button + reset button + akun-info), pasien login + onboarding render, bottom nav + disclaimer. Backend fully validated: akun create/get/reset (old password invalidated), pasien JWT role isolation (pasien token → 403 on /api/patients; admin token → 403 on /api/pasien/me; no token → 401), onboarding profil persistence, pemantauan harian (DANGER_LABELS detection: perdarahan+sakit_kepala → tanda_bahaya correctly flagged), mingguan (ada_bahaya), ttd (sudah/tidak + alasan + invalid 400), gerakan ($inc), persiapan/pengingat persist, edukasi-klinik sync (klinik posts edukasi → pasien sees it in current fase).

minor.issue: Does NOT cascade-delete related portal data: patient_users, pemantauan_harian, pemantauan_mingguan, ttd, gerakan, persiapan, pengingat. Orphan rows remain (confirmed via mongosh). Users deleted via UI would leave their portal account + health data orphaned. Had to clean up manually.
No brute-force lockout for patient login (admin has 5-fail lockout). Patient portal login allows unlimited password attempts.

action_items: Add cascade delete on DELETE /api/patients/{id} to also remove patient_users and related pemantauan/ttd/gerakan/mingguan/persiapan/pengingat rows (prevents orphan portal accounts + GDPR hygiene).
Consider adding login_attempts/lockout for POST /api/pasien/login (symmetry with klinik auth).
critical_code_review_comments: server.py (1216 lines) is approaching the 700-line split threshold; recommend splitting portal_pasien routes into a separate router module (e.g. routers/pasien.py) in a future iteration.
DELETE /api/patients does not cascade — risk of orphan portal accounts and health data (see minor backend issue above).
No rate limiting / brute-force protection on /api/pasien/login.
Onboarding select options use labels only (A, B, AB, O, Belum tahu) — not 'O+' / 'O-' etc. Fine functionally but potentially less clinical granularity than typical blood-type UIs.
patient_users unique index on username is good; collision retry loop in create_akun_pasien is correct.

success_rate.frontend: 90% (akun flow + login + onboarding render verified via Playwright; remaining pasien pages validated via API tests; one UI script option-value mismatch was a test-script issue not a product bug)
